messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — new staging build of l2-llm-int8 is producing malformed JSON in function/tool-call outputs. Quick run (5k): schema_compliance_rate=94.7%, avg_parse_attempts=1.42, token_cost +0.3%, p95 latency +30ms. Sample failures below. :eyes:
Sam Ortiz: Can you paste a couple of raw outputs so we can see the failure modes?
Maya Patel: Sure — two representative outputs:
```
1) 'result': {'score': 0.92, 'items': ['a','b',],}
2) INFO: returning object -> {status: success, value: 42} extra text
```
Sam Ortiz: ugh, trailing comma + single quotes + bare keys + stray prefix.
Priya Shah: Looks like quantized model shifted generation tokens. We should try a lenient pre-parse repair step rather than immediately failing and retrying the model.
Diego Ramos: Proposed pipeline:
1) strict json.loads parse
2) if fail -> apply tiny heuristic repairs (trailing commas, single->double quotes, wrap bare keys, strip non-json prefix)
3) reparse -> if still fail, retry model in function-call-only mode with lower temp
4) fallback: call dedicated "format_json" tool to attempt structured recovery
Jing Wu: Add telemetry: parse_attempts, repairs_applied (list), repair_latency_ms, model_variant. We'll want per-model and per-prompt buckets.
eval-bot: eval run (10k prompts) summary: raw_malformed=6.1%, repaired_success=3.8%, final_unparseable=2.3%. avg_repair_latency_ms=22. Full csv: https://s3.redwood-inference/internal/evals/1756801234/repair-summary.csv
Sam Ortiz: Which heuristics contributed most to successful repairs?
eval-bot: breakdown: trailing_commas_fixed: 42%, single_quotes_fixed: 35%, bare_keys_quoted: 18%, stray_prefix_trim: 5%.
Priya Shah: Nice. We should be explicit about which repairs are allowed for which customers (opt-in) — enterprise might want strict-only. Add a feature flag per-deployment.
Maya Patel: Quick poc fixer (python):
```python
import re, json
def attempt_repair(s):
    try:
        return json.loads(s)
    except Exception:
        # common fixes
        s2 = re.sub(r",\s*}\", '\}', s)
        s2 = s2.replace("'", '"')
        s2 = re.sub(r"([\{,\s])(\w+):", r'\1"\2":', s2)
        s2 = re.sub(r"^[^\{\[]+", '', s2)
        return json.loads(s2)
```
Diego Ramos: I'll add a small repair stage module and wire it into the funcall parsing path. Telemetry snippet (log fields):
```
telemetry: {
  model: "l2-llm-int8",
  parse_attempts: 2,
  repairs_applied: ["trailing_commas","single_quotes"],
  repair_time_ms: 18
}
```
Priya Shah: Also add a unit-test harness that mutates valid JSON (insert trailing commas, remove quotes, add prefix garbage) and assert repair coverage + regression limits. We must monitor downstream correctness — repaired JSON may still semantically differ.
Maya Patel: I'll run a 50k run with repairs enabled and collect metrics against the golden ground-truth. Posting results in #eng-ml when done. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy started for staging/service-l2-int8 at 1756803000 :rocket:
Sam Ortiz: added a short note to the onboarding doc about "lenient-repair" flag + tradeoffs.
Jing Wu: One more ask: add a per-model opt-out label so model owners can mark "no-repair-allowed" for safety-critical outputs.
Priya Shah: Agreed. We'll schedule a quick sync after the 50k run to decide default behavior and opt-in gating. :calendar:
Maya Patel: Thanks all — I'll kick off the job this morning and grab logs for the top 500 failures for manual review.
